technical_scope: D1 single P2; exploratory mean30 reused from C versus newly fitted none30; no D2

baseline.origin: mean30 retained output and measured C costs; no C fit repeated
baseline.historical_document_hash_scope: C pilotage hashes belong to revision5eb82ba, not HEAD D1

enforcement.aggregate_rss: controller current RSS plus worker VmHWM/current RSS; inherited diagnostic supervisor terminates worker on limit
enforcement.worker_termination: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 2 seconds if still alive
enforcement.phase_output: inherited diagnostic worker byte budget plus controller directory polling

selection_lock.duration_source: fixed by C selection and the pinned D1 protocol; no D1 tuning grid

primary_contrast.metric: micro recall@10, historical product support >=1, pooled 2024Q1-2025Q4

capacity.interpretation: none has 64 fewer active shared transformation scalars; node-identity vectors remain trainable in both

costs.origin: none30 phase costs measured in D1; mean30 costs reused from C and kept separately

mean30_reused_C.origin: measured in C and reused; no mean30 D1 refit

optimization.loss_semantics: mean softplus(-margin) before updates; regularization not included; none final loss near ln(2), no tuning after observation

scope.prepared_snapshots: streamed 2019Q1–2025Q4; first-occurrence positive labels, historical product support, and candidate relations independently derived
scope.prediction_stream_coverage: all eligible candidate pairs; deterministic sampling: none; every none score/rank/label and EOF checked

tolerance.integers_and_strings: exact; booleans are not accepted as integers
tolerance.candidate_ids_hash: exact SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON list, ensure_ascii=False

selection_lock_order.ordering_basis: local Linux file birth and trace modification timestamps; traces contain fit_started before quarter evaluation and each test trace is born after its allowed predecessor

numeric_audit.resource_interpretation: VmHWM118292480 and cumulative ru_maxrss571580416 diverge; no startup readings or global audit RSS-under512MiB certification; training phase limits separately measured
numeric_audit.raw_counter_name_caveat: candidate_ids_compared_per_model=9187488 is total across both exports; paired candidate/prediction items=4593744

rss_probe.conclusion: VmHWM resets across exec on the same PID; ru_maxrss retains the earlier image high-water mark
rss_probe.limitation: D1 audit has no startup RSS readings; this probe does not establish the precise origin of its earlier 571580416-byte cumulative high-water mark; both audit readings remain unchanged

rendering.visual_inspection: PNG2484x1835 opened by renderer and parent; labels/loss series/result bars inspected; no epoch0 point

interpretation.remaining: A/B human review, historical public availability, authors/declarations/editorial target, manuscript E and decision F remain open

preservation: RC1, A/B/C manifests/ledgers, benchmark summary, main and four tags not replaced; preexisting root README DOI fix and three manuscript audit files excluded
artifact_hash_cycle_policy: manifest does not hash itself, its ledger or inventory entries containing its own hash; inventory and ledger frozen afterward
